about: ADR citation cases that the spec's checker (docs/spec/FirSpecSite/Tests.lean) and the adr-citations hook (scripts/test_check_adr_citations.py) both pass: citations lists each citation outside code as LINE:COLUMN and its text, and errors the messages of a check of the file a.md, given the ids of known.

cases.about: A citation ends at the last digit of its id.
Six digits are a whole id of their own, not ADR-2026-10-30-1031 and more.
errors: a.md:1:5: ADR-2026-10-30-103112 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: A six-digit id is cited whole.
errors: a.md:1:27: ADR-2026-11-03-0107 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: Citations follow each other.
Five digits are malformed.
errors: a.md:1:1: ADR-2026-10-30-10311 is not an ADR id, which ends in HHMM or HHMMSS

cases.about: Seven digits are malformed.
errors: a.md:1:1: ADR-2026-10-30-1031123 is not an ADR id, which ends in HHMM or HHMMSS

cases.about: Placeholders are not citations.
Punctuation around a citation is not part of it.
A citation can start inside a word and ends at its last digit.
Only upper-case ADR- starts a citation.
A date that is not real names no ADR.
errors: a.md:1:1: ADR-2026-02-30-1200 names no ADR in docs/adrs/
a.md:1:25: ADR-2026-10-30-2460 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: Only ASCII digits are digits.
errors: a.md:1:25: ADR-2026-10-30-103 is not an ADR id, which ends in HHMM or HHMMSS

cases.about: Columns count characters, not bytes.
errors: a.md:1:29: ADR-2026-10-30-9999 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: A code span is quoted, not cited.
A code span closes at a run of backticks of its own length.
A longer run of backticks does not close a code span.
errors: a.md:1:28: ADR-2026-10-30-9998 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: An unclosed backtick opens no code span.
A fenced code block is quoted, fences included.
A tilde fence, indented by spaces, opens a block until the next fence.
errors: a.md:4:1: ADR-2026-10-30-9997 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: A tab before backticks makes no fence.
errors: a.md:2:1: ADR-2026-10-30-9999 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: A line that starts with three backticks is a fence, even if it closes them.
Lines end at a line feed; a carriage return is a character.
errors: a.md:2:1: ADR-2026-10-30-9999 names no ADR in docs/adrs/
a.md:3:3: ADR-2026-10-29-2099 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: Each citation that names no ADR is located.
errors: a.md:2:3: ADR-2026-10-29-2099 names no ADR in docs/adrs/

cases.about: A malformed citation is located.
errors: a.md:1:1: ADR-2026-10-29-20150 is not an ADR id, which ends in HHMM or HHMMSS
